profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: Creative, quality-focused software developer and leader. Relentless troubleshooter and bug-hunter. Effectively collaborates with nontechnical stakeholders and fellow technologists to build solutions.

positions.title: Director of Engineering
positions.description: Built and led teams responsible for Gilt's custom backoffice systems: Recruited, trained, managed, and mentored engineers and engineering leads for systems used for critical business processes: procurement and management of inventory, content production and management, order processing, and financial reporting. Provided architectural oversight of development of new features and systems, including Gilt's introduction of international shipping. Acted as advisor to customer-facing development teams to ensure that they appropriately considered backend and operations impact of the features they were developing. Continued to do development of small features and bugfixes.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Primary developer on several major projects, including a white-label site for a well-known fashion magazine and the launch of a new distribution center. Made numerous improvements to Gilt's tools for warehouse and financial operations to support Gilt's evolving business, and supported users of said tools. Mentored many junior developers.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Conceived and implemented optimizations that dramatically reduced the hardware resources required for server log analytics. Designed and implemented tools to automate management of the log analysis system. Provided training and mentorship to new developers to help them become productive in Akamai's unique engineering and operational environment.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Following  IMLogic's acquisition by Symantic, aided in transition of IMLogic products into Symantec's portfolio.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on several releases of server applications that acted as proxies for various instant messaging protocols. Played a variety of roles, from "Quick Fix Engineer" troubleshooting defects reported by customers after release, to de-facto sales engineer assisting on deals with potential big-name customers, to Senior Software Engineer owning major features from start to finish. Contributing inventor and lead engineer on malware detection system that led to 4 patents (USPTO 7577993, 7600258, 7822818, and 7823200).
